findings.claim: This is the only witness for PACKAGE writing `policy_sha` on a differing declaration, and acceptance criterion 3 explicitly requires that a recorded sha of NULL counts as 'different' and gets written — yet this test overwrites the fixture's naturally-NULL `policy_sha` (packageable's `create_task` call passes no `policy_sha`) with a non-NULL `old_sha` before calling `package()`. Changing `saffron/phases/package.py:771` from `if ledger.task_policy_sha(outcome.task_id) != policy_sha:` to `if (recorded := ledger.task_policy_sha(outcome.task_id)) is not None and recorded != policy_sha:` keeps both this test and the no-op test (`test_reverifying_under_an_unchanged_policy_issues_no_policy_write`, which also seeds a non-NULL value) green, while a task that never had a `policy_sha` recorded (every pre-existing task, and the exact gap backlog item 16 exists to close) would silently never get one written on re-verification. No gate catches this: `criteria` only checks that a witness exists per checklist item, not that it exercises every clause of item 3.
